evidence: Modifies src/validation.cpp and src/validation.h to decouple CheckBlockHeader and ContextualCheckBlock from ChainstateManager, adding comprehensive unit tests.
rationale: Decoupling header and block validation from ChainstateManager and system clock enables direct unit testing of consensus rules in isolation. As noted by reviewers, taking explicit parameters directly allows testing validation error cases with simple inputs and unblocks tracking issue #35904, though it is reasonably deferrable architectural work.
